title: The Big Void as a heat exchanger for reactions in the Grand Gallery
summary: Jeffrey tells of The Big Void as a heat exchanger for reactions in the Grand Gallery, about an unknown time at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: For example, the big void, it's in a perfect location for a heat exchanger.

plain: Inside the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt there is a large empty space called the Big Void, sitting above the Grand Gallery, a tall sloping corridor. A researcher named Jeffrey, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says the Big Void sits in a perfect spot to act as a heat exchanger for chemical reactions he believes took place in the Grand Gallery. If so, the pyramid would have worked as a kind of machine rather than only a tomb.
